hypothesis: A large directional H1 shock whose range is abnormal relative to prior ATR can temporarily exhaust order flow; a prompt close back through a frozen fraction of the shock bar may identify a short-lived reversal.
derivation_disclosure: New price-only mechanism. Existing capitulation_d1 supplies only the qualitative idea that forced directional moves may rebound; none of its thresholds, timeframe, assets or quantitative evidence are reused. V18 code may be reused solely for tested account sizing and cost mechanics.

temporal_evidence_contract.reason: Crypto performance through 2025H1 has been inspected by earlier families.

data_contract.input: independently checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC H1
data_contract.shock_information: completed shock H1 OHLC and ATR14 computed only from bars available at its close
data_contract.reclaim_information: completed closes after the shock; entry at the next complete H1 open
data_contract.session_block: shock hour belongs to fixed 00-07, 08-15 or 16-23 UTC block
data_contract.day_group: weekday or weekend from shock timestamp
data_contract.proxy_limitation: No execution promotion before native Ostium coverage/parity

execution_contract.shock: long setup requires shock close/previous close - 1 <= -shock_return and true range >= range_atr times prior ATR14; short is symmetric
execution_contract.reclaim_level: shock low plus reclaim_fraction of shock high-low for long; shock high minus the same fraction for short
execution_contract.trigger: first completed close through the frozen reclaim level within reclaim_hours; no trigger on the shock bar
execution_contract.entry: next complete H1 open after trigger
execution_contract.stop: stop_atr times shock-time ATR from entry, gap-adverse
execution_contract.exit: stop or close after 2/6/12 H1 bars
execution_contract.position_policy: one open position per asset/candidate; later shocks ignored until exit

stability.representative: graph medoid of largest stable component per categorical group without performance metrics

small_account.leverage_rule: Highest venue leverage whose approximate liquidation distance is at least 1.25 times the stop distance; reject if collateral exceeds 35% of capital.

family_stop_rule.stop_after_internal_walk_forward_if: zero frozen representatives pass every aggregate gate
family_stop_rule.global_holdout_policy: Survivors enter a final-cohort waitlist; this family cannot open the holdout alone.
family_stop_rule.sqcli_policy: A survivor may be reproduced/retested in SQ on consumed research periods, but SQ results cannot authorize performance promotion.
